messages:
leo_chen: FYI urgent from support — PivotalHealth (acct PH-472) onboarding stalled for 3 weeks. Trial seats are dropping and AM flagged a renewal risk. Need CS to pick this up and a short comms/playbook we can send to the customer.

maya_patel: copying in @zara_alvarez and @raj_singh. core ask: what exactly is blocking provisioning? any temporary unblocks?

leo_chen: Root cause looks like SSO handshake errors + intermittent provisioning 502s during key rotation window. Customer sees IdP 400/invalid_certificate and our provisioning-bot logged repeated retries. They want a timeline or an unblock option.

raj_singh: repro'd the SAML flow, getting `invalid_certificate` from the IdP on POST /saml/acs. Support opened a ticket with IdP vendor, but ETA is unclear. Also saw provisioning-bot spike errs around 2026-03-14T18:22Z: `503 upstream unavailable`.

maya_patel: Proposed swift plan (short):
- Assign a CSM for high-touch (owner: CS)
- Book a 30–45m technical onboarding call within 24–48h (include engineering)
- Offer a temporary auth fallback (API-key) to unblock trial seats if customer agrees
- Prepare a renewal mitigation note for AM (extension / credit options)
- Escalate infra if provisioning-bot 502s persist
Who can own comms + draft email?

zara_alvarez: I can lead comms. @maya_patel please draft a 2-paragraph email (context + proposed steps) and an actionable checklist; I'll review and send by 5pm PT. Also scheduling: propose call tomorrow 10am PT. @raj_singh please join for triage.

raj_singh: I'll join. Quick technical fallback: temporary API-key auth is simple to enable on our side for a limited scope, but needs a short consent + legal signoff. If customer accepts, it can buy time while IdP rotates certs.

leo_chen: Customer indicated they'd accept a temporary key for up to 2 weeks if we provide a safe plan. They're concerned about data residency/privacy — need legal to weigh in. @legal-team can you advise on short consent language / risks?

maya_patel: Looping legal. Drafting the email & checklist now; will post draft here in ~20m. Draft checklist will include: prep steps, attendees, roles (CS owner, support lead, eng triage), temporary auth opt-in flow, rollback plan, renewal mitigation offer.

zara_alvarez: :thumbsup: Add a measurable target: 70% seat activation within 7 days post-call or we trigger a 30-day renewal extension. Also capture baseline metrics (DAU, auth success rate) before/after.

provision-bot: provisioning retries=5 -> entering backoff window, last_error=503_upstream_unavailable.

leo_chen: Thank you. I'll update the AM and flag as P1-escalation in our CRM. Next steps: Maya to post draft, Zara to review + send, Raj to prepare triage notes, Legal to confirm consent language.

maya_patel: Draft posted: short customer-friendly summary + 3 bullet next steps. Sharing now...

zara_alvarez: Got it, reviewing. Will confirm send time once legal weighs in.

leo_chen: Closing loop on support side for now. Please keep thread updated with send + call notes so AM can report to the customer.

maya_patel: Will do.

zara_alvarez: Thanks all — let's aim to have the call scheduled and the temporary auth option readied before EOD.
file_notes: escalation thread: urgent support -> CS for high-touch onboarding, contains proposed comms plan, technical fallback and legal loop
